ios.desc:
Track feeding, sleep, diapers, growth, and everyday baby care without creating an account. With Buggy, your baby’s data stays on your phone—not in a cloud account or on our servers.

YOUR BABY’S DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE

• No account required
• No ads or ad tracking
• No cloud sync for baby logs
• Works offline for everyday logging
• Your family’s data stays under your control

TRY BUGGY WITH YOUR ROUTINE

Set up your baby, explore the app, and log your first activity free.

• One-tap feeding, sleep, diaper, pumping, and growth tracking
• Clean daily journal and growth trends
• Retroactive activity and growth entries
• Multiple languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, Italian, and French

UNLOCK BUGGY

Continue logging and unlock the full experience:

• Complete history and growth records
• Smart tools for everyday parenting questions
• WHO growth percentile references
• Custom activity types
• Extra baby profiles
• All color themes
• CSV export and pediatrician-ready PDF reports
• Ongoing feature updates

DESIGNED FOR REAL PARENT LIFE

Fast, one-handed logging. A clean, intuitive journal. Useful guides for feeding, sleep, fever, milestones, and more.

Built by a parent for parents.

Buggy offers optional auto-renewing Weekly and Annual subscriptions. The Annual plan includes a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Pricing may vary by region. Payment is charged to your Apple Account after any trial period and subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Purchases, restores, and entitlement checks are handled through the App Store and may require an internet connection. Your baby logs stay on your phone.

Private by default. Practical every day.

Terms of Use: https://www.buggybaby.app/terms-of-use

quotes.text:
I became a dad recently and couldn’t find a baby tracker that didn’t require an account or cloud sync. So I built Buggy:

- Works fully offline; data is stored locally on device
- No account, no analytics SDKs, no ads
- 2-tap logging for feeds, diapers, sleep; simple charts for patterns
- Paid upfront (€2.99) so there’s no subscription or tracking

Tech: React Native / Expo No 3rd-party SDKs; the app doesn’t make network calls during use.

Links:
- App Store -> https://apps.apple.com/app/buggy-baby-tracker-log/id6748351234
- Landing -> https://buggybaby.app/
